en: Choose Wan or LTX. Model selection loads efficient defaults automatically. Character replacement and Phantom use their dedicated Wan models. Ingredients draws one first frame of all the pictures with an installed FLUX 3 Klein (the image checkpoint stays as chosen), then the chosen video model animates it; without FLUX 3 it uses Phantom.

en: Wan: Forge draws the first frame with the image checkpoint, then Wan animates it. LTX: generates video and optional synchronized sound directly from the video prompt.
ctx: [t] Video Studio LTX model selection and audio-driven video

en: LTX: animate a picture to your audio. Speech and singing drive the video. Choose an LTX model above, add the picture and recording, then describe the scene. Length controls how much audio is used; the original audio is preserved in the result.
